issue.title: gateway: SophNet's model-scoped 429 ("Model tpm limit exceeded") rests the whole key, greying out every model on it
issue.body:
## Summary

When a SophNet model answers a **model-scoped** 429, magpie rests the **whole API key**, so every sibling model on that key is greyed out on the Routing page (`rate limited · back in 59 s`) and gets a local 429 without the request ever reaching upstream.

This is the same shape as #3039 (a relay's `for model <X>` 429) and #3213 (Qoder's per-model 503), but it arrives with **different wording** that none of the existing matchers catch:

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests

{"error":{"message":"SophNet: Model tpm limit exceeded. Please try again later."}}
```

## Evidence from the gateway trace

A group `group/deepseek-v4-flash` with three members on one SophNet key. The first member gets the 429 above, and `/api/gateway/trace` records the rest against the **key**:

```json
{
  "id": "sophnet",
  "model": "DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017",
  "status": 429,
  "fail": "rate",
  "error": "SophNet: Model tpm limit exceeded. Please try again later.",
  "rest": {
    "why": "rate",
    "status": 429,
    "until": "2026-10-25T22:54:24Z",
    "by": "cooldown",
    "failures": 1,
    "key": "sophnet@api key …pncw"      // ← whole key, not restID()
  }
}
```

The next two members were tried within ~1s and each got its own 429, after which all three rows showed `rate limited · back in 59 s`. The same happens for every other model on that key.

## Expected

Recognise `Model <name> limit exceeded` (and similar "the limit is for this model" phrasing) as a **model-scoped** refusal and call `c.restID()` instead of `c.restKey()`, like `otherModels` does for `switch to other models` in #3039.

The distinction matters here: SophNet's console exposes per-model TPM/RPM (e.g. 600k TPM, 120 RPM per model), so a `Model tpm limit exceeded` does not necessarily mean the key's whole quota is gone. If the sibling models are in fact on a shared pool, letting the request go upstream and answer its own 429 is still more truthful than pre-emptively refusing it locally with another model's error text.

## Trade-off worth considering

I understand the conservative choice (don't hammer a key that just 429'd). A middle ground could be: rest the model immediately, but for siblings only apply a short "probe" cooldown (or none), and rest the whole key only if a second distinct model on the same key also 429s.

## Environment

- magpie 0.1.1543, Linux (workstation), custom SophNet plugin provider (`@ai-sdk/openai` / `@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`, per-model `limit.context` / `limit.output`)
- Three channels under one SophNet API key: `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017`, `-global`, `DeepSeek-Flash-1017`, routed `order`/`auto`
- Reproduced by sending concurrent requests through the group until SophNet answers `Model tpm limit exceeded`

## Workaround

Routing page → `Try now` on the key lifts the rest immediately (as #3039 notes); restarting magpie also clears it.

comments.body:
The wording reads the model as the one limited, but nothing in the rest ladder knew it: `Model tpm limit exceeded` matched no word list, so the 429 fell to the key-wide rest, and every sibling on the SophNet key greyed out with a local 429 naming another model's error — your trace's `rest.key: sophnet@api key …`.

Fixed on [fix/sophnet-model-429](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/sophnet-model-429) (`466a153c`, based on today's `main`): `modelRateLimit` recognizes the model-scoped wording — the limit kind named (`tpm`/`rpm`/`qps`/requests/rate), a model name or none between "model" and it — and such a 429 rests by `restID()`, beside the existing `otherModels` and Cline free-limit decisions. The key's other models keep serving; a rate limit that names no model rests the key as before.

On the trade-off you raised: this takes the straightforward side — the model rests at once (it answers its own 429 verbatim if asked anyway), each sibling that hits its own TPM rests on its own refusal, and nothing is fed into the key's failure backoff. `docs/subsystems/gateway-routing.md` documents the decision.

- Red → green: `TestModelRateLimitRestsTheModel` uses your JSON fixture verbatim plus the bare-message, named-model and `\uXXXX`-escaped forms, asserts the sibling models are not resting, and that a plain `Too many requests` still rests the key.
- Full `internal/gateway` (`-tags nogui`): 5172 passed, the one red the known environmental `TestClaudeClientCacheAbsentUnchanged` (#3280), red on a clean base here too.

No real SophNet account was called; the fix is worded so your exact trace is the test.

Fixed on `fix/3619-model-scoped-rate-limit` (0c5a9d458ba086e19bfd9caa359719f12fea5e46).

When a SophNet key has three members on it and the first gets back `"Model tpm limit exceeded"`, the rest was recorded on the whole API key (`sophnet`), so every sibling model was greyed out on Routing and refused locally without reaching upstream.

Root cause: `restAfterMarked` and `rateRest` chose between `restKey()` and `restID()` for rate limits only for OpenRouter free-tier pools and remote-magpie model rests. A model-scoped wording like `"Model tpm limit exceeded"` or `"RPM limit exceeded for model X"` was not matched, so the whole key rested.

Fix: added `modelRateWords` (a regexp matching `model … tpm|rpm|limit|…` or the reversed form) to both `rateRest` (which picks the rest scope for the sink) and `restAfterMarked` (which records `r.Key`). When the wording is model-scoped, `restID()` is used instead of `restKey()`, exactly as `otherModels` does for WorkBuddy's "switch to other models."

Tests: `TestModelRateLimitRestsTheModelAlone` was red before (`Key="sophnet"` instead of `sophnet/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017`) and is green after; `TestKeyRateLimitRestsTheKey` verifies a plain `Too Many Requests` still rests the whole key. `gofmt`, `go build -tags nogui ./...`, `go vet` clean. Full gateway package run under way; targeted test green.

Tests: `TestModelRateLimitRestsTheModelAlone` was red before (`Key="sophnet"` instead of `sophnet/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017`) and is green after; `TestKeyRateLimitRestsTheKey` verifies a plain `Too Many Requests` still rests the whole key. `gofmt`, `go build -tags nogui ./...`, `go vet` clean. Full gateway package run under way; targeted test green.

Verification of @skygunner's branch — I'm not proposing a patch here, the fix is theirs; I ran an independent check of `fix/3619-model-scoped-rate-limit` and can't endorse it as-is: the SophNet mechanism is right and locked by its tests, but the branch regresses an in-repo test that pins OpenRouter's account-wide free-model rate limit (#153). Evidence below.

**Mechanism, self-description vs. diff** (commit 0c5a9d458, cited in the comments above; 2 files, +88 lines, nothing out of scope):

| Claim | In the diff | Measured |
| --- | --- | --- |
| "Model tpm limit exceeded" is read as model-scoped | new `modelRateWords` word list, matched via `wordsOf` | yes — the test asserts it; ablation run prints `modelRate=true` |
| such a 429 rests by `restID()`, not `restKey()` | injection in `restAfterMarked` before `r.Key = id`, plus an `else if` in `rateRest` | yes |
| the key's other models keep serving | no key rest on model-scoped wording | yes — test asserts `restOf(restKey())` stays empty |
| a plain "Too Many Requests" still rests the key | no word-list match falls through to the key | yes — `TestKeyRateLimitRestsTheKey` |

**Verification** (tip = today's `main` e17b6cefc; the branch's base is a month old, 1517 commits behind):

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `TestModelRateLimitRestsTheModelAlone` on the fix's parent 20b35df55 (test + word list planted, no code change) | RED — `Key="sophnet"`, want `sophnet/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017` |
| same test, fix injections removed at tip (ablation) | RED — same signature, reported symptom verbatim |
| the branch's two tests on the branch head | ok |
| 3-way apply of the patch onto tip | one conflict in the regexp block (main added `modelCooling` there, #3039); keeping both word lists resolves it, then it lands; the new test file applies clean |
| full `go test -tags nogui ./internal/gateway/` on tip + 0c5a9d458 | **1 FAIL: `TestOpenRouterFreeAccountRateLimitKeepsProviderRest`** (602 s, no other failure) |
| `-race` over the Rest/Rate tests | fails on the same test; no race report — it is wording, not concurrency |
| gofmt / vet / build -tags nogui | routing.go clean, vet clean, build ok; **the branch head's `model_limit_rest_test.go` is missing the trailing newline** (gofmt flags it on the branch itself) |

**What blocks the endorsement.** `TestOpenRouterFreeAccountRateLimitKeepsProviderRest` (9e37a6929, 2026-09-28, present in the branch's own base) pins that OpenRouter's **account-wide** "Rate limit exceeded: free-models-per-min" keeps the **provider** rest key (`orf`). It passes on clean main and on the pristine base, and fails on the branch — at the branch's own base and at current tip alike:

| Tree | #153 test |
| --- | --- |
| clean tip | PASS |
| pristine branch base | PASS |
| base + branch head | FAIL — rest lands on `orf/x/a:free` instead of `orf` |
| tip + 0c5a9d458 | FAIL (the only red in the full gateway run) |
| tip + branch head | FAIL |

Instrumented run at the branch head shows why. The head is not the commit cited in the comments: a second commit, e9307596c07d3a513764d878199f13c3a08b83b8, narrows the reverse alternative to `(?:for|on) (?:the )?model` and adds a `freeModelsPerMin` exclusion — but two defects remain there:

1. the forward alternative `model.{0,40}(limit|quota|tpm|rpm|rate|throttl)` still matches, because the fuller JSON body bridges "model" (in "free-models-per-min") to "rate" (in `"type":"rate_limit_error"`) within the 40-char window across envelope fields — so the model-scoped injection fires anyway;
2. the new exclusion branch sets `id = provider.KeyAllowanceID(c.p)`, which is the **empty string** for a key whose windows magpie does not read — even when nothing overrides it, the rest would be keyed under `""`, not `orf`.

Net effect: a key-wide, account-level OpenRouter limit would rest one model only and leave its siblings asking — the exact grey-out shape #153 fixed, now for the account-wide wording instead of the pooled one.

**Not verified:** no real SophNet account was called (as the fix's author also stated — the reported JSON is the test fixture); provider wordings beyond the in-repo suite were not enumerated.

The direction itself is sound and matches the issue's ask (`restID` for model-scoped wording, same shape as the existing `otherModels`/`modelCooledDown` decisions in the same block); with the #153 collision above fixed — and the branch head SHA referenced in the comments, since both comments still cite 0c5a9d458 — this should be straightforward to re-issue.

Branch: skygunner/magpie `fix/3619-model-scoped-rate-limit`, head e9307596c07d3a513764d878199f13c3a08b83b8 (comments cite the earlier 0c5a9d458).

Thanks @zisen123 for the report and @skygunner for the fix branch.

AI use: verification performed with AI assistance; all commands and outputs above were run and read locally.

Both findings hold — thank you, this is exactly the check the branch needed — and the branch is rewritten: [fix/3619-model-scoped-rate-limit](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/3619-model-scoped-rate-limit) is now one commit, [`bbd53987c`](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/bbd53987c389f89caba670c3d121f344d3d8b594), on current `upstream/main` (`2df5d40ee`), force-pushed over the two commits you tested (old tip `e9307596c`).

You caught two real defects, and I could reproduce both before touching anything: the first commit's unwindowed reverse alternative (`limit…{0,40}model`) matches OpenRouter's account-wide wording on its own — I re-ran `TestOpenRouterFreeAccountRateLimitKeepsProviderRest` at the old head and got your red (`orf/x/a:free` instead of `orf`) — and the second commit's exclusion set `id = provider.KeyAllowanceID(c.p)`, the empty string for a key whose windows magpie doesn't read, so the rest keyed under `""` even where the narrowed regex no longer matched.

What the rewrite does instead of an exclusion:

- The word-list window can no longer cross the JSON's quotes or braces: `model[^"{}\n]{0,40}(limit|quota|tpm|rpm|rate|throttl)`, and the narrowed reverse form carries the same window class. "free-models-per-min" can no longer bridge to `"type":"rate_limit_error"` across envelope fields, so an account-wide limit keeps the key rest — for any vendor's wording, not OpenRouter by name.
- No preset exclusion and no `KeyAllowanceID` call anywhere: nothing can rest under the empty id.
- gofmt clean; the missing trailing newline in `model_limit_rest_test.go` fixed.

Green on the head: the two tests this fix brought (`TestModelRateLimitRestsTheModelAlone` — SophNet's "Model tpm limit exceeded" and the reversed wording — plus `TestKeyRateLimitRestsTheKey`), a new `TestOpenRouterAccountWideWordingRestsTheKey` pinning both the short body and the fuller real shape (`"type":"rate_limit_error"` sitting after the message, a provider field behind it — the bridge a `.{0,40}` window misread), and the in-repo #153 test. Full `go test -tags nogui ./internal/gateway/` on the head: only the five baseline reds clean `upstream/main` shows in this environment (FuzzMarshalRaw, TestClaudeClientCacheAbsentUnchanged, TestMarshalRawIsEncodingJSON, TestMarshalSizedIsJSONMarshal, TestServeWSLListensBesideLoopback — identical set on `2df5d40ee`), nothing else.
